info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Retrieval API facilitates access to the specific loyalty rules established by the organization. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about various loyalty rules designed to enhance customer engagement and reward programs. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and business analysts looking to implement or analyze loyalty strategies. By integrating this API, businesses can leverage existing loyalty frameworks to improve customer retention and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the complete list of loyalty rules available in the system, providing insights into how customers can benefit from the loyalty program.
